{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the actual sites
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id rows:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for assay_batch B and its unit issue
print("Assay batch A count:", (df['assay_batch'] == 'A').sum())
print("Assay batch B count:", (df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum())

# Check sample_seq distribution
print("Max sample_seq per patient:", df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
print("Patients with multiple sample_seq:", (df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max() > 1).sum())"}
